changes.title: Pack aim
items: Pack combat: animals in a pack no longer miss you as you walk away: their bolts lead you properly, and the ones right beside you lunge too

changes.title: Grounded solid
items: When your followers are too heavy to take off with, their leashes flash into solid lines as they pull you back down (they no longer stay bright the whole time)
Trying to take off while dancing by the dancefloor with heavy followers now stops the dance, so you see yourself pulled back down
You no longer blink out of sight at the top of a pulled-down take-off

changes.title: Packs phase1
items: Pack combat (still on the pause page's switch) now covers the next eleven animals too: wolves howl and strike together, boars charge in a line, bats' screech turns your steering, ravens leave dark images of the flock that soak up your 💌s, herons blink in where you blink, toads leap in on a spore cloud, and more
